key.name: panel-items
key.summary: Items shown in the top bar
key.description: Any of: cpu, pressure, cpu-temp, memory, gpu, alert.

key.name: sensor-overrides
key.description: JSON object keyed by sensor: hidden, label, minRpm, zeroRpm, maxTemp.

key.name: known-fans
key.summary: Fans that have been seen spinning
key.description: A fan never seen spinning is treated as not connected and raises no alerts.

key.name: alert-fan
key.summary: Alert when a fan stalls or stops

key.name: fan-stall-pwm
key.summary: PWM duty (%) above which a fan at 0 RPM counts as stalled

key.name: fan-stall-seconds
key.summary: Seconds a fan problem must last before alerting

key.name: alert-temp
key.summary: Alert when a sensor reaches its temperature limit

key.name: alert-disk
key.summary: Alert when a filesystem is almost full

key.name: disk-free-percent
key.summary: Free space (%) below which a filesystem counts as almost full

key.name: disk-alert-ignore
key.summary: Filesystems that never raise a space alert

key.name: alert-swap
key.summary: Alert when memory spills into swap on disk

key.name: swap-alert-mib
key.summary: Swap on disk (MiB) that triggers the alert

key.name: thrash-percent
key.summary: Memory "full" pressure (%, 10 s average) that counts as thrashing

key.name: cpu-pressure-percent
key.summary: CPU "some" pressure (%, 1 min average) that triggers an alert; 0 turns it off

key.name: io-pressure-percent
key.summary: I/O "full" pressure (%, 10 s average) that triggers an alert; 0 turns it off

key.name: notify-recovery
key.summary: Notify when an alert condition is over
